name: Hydrophobicity Profile
description: Compute the Kyte-Doolittle hydrophobicity score for each residue in a protein sequence. Peaks in the profile identify transmembrane helices and signal peptides; troughs mark solvent-exposed loops. The AMINO_HYDROPHOBIC tile maps each 5-bit residue code to its K-D scale value using the preloaded constant table — a direct application of the address-as-identity, preloaded-table model. A sliding window average (window=9 or 19) smooths the raw per-residue scores.
author: system

pipeline.note: Table-lookup hydrophobicity value per residue (preloaded K-D scale)
Downstream: MIF_ADD sliding sum / MIF_DIV by window for smoothed profile

expected_output: hydrophobicity_score per residue (MIF float, K-D scale -4.5 to +4.5)
validation: Ile (I) = +4.5 (most hydrophobic). Arg (R) = -4.5 (most hydrophilic). Known TM helix segments score >1.6 over a 19-residue window.
